Componentwise-dominating sorted ancestry clade profiles give a global optimizer for all q in (0,1). Exhaustive recursive generation of unordered rooted binary shapes gives counts 1,1,2,3,6,11 for n=2..7 and 23 for n=8, all shapes <=7 have a common dominator; the displayed 8-tip shape competes via profiles (1,2,4,5) and (1,2,3), whose difference is q^3(q^2+q-1) and crosses once at p=(3-sqrt5)/2. These calculations were independently regenerated. Does not extend to unequal branch lengths, survival risks, or multiple protected leaves.
